cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a martial training yard with weapon racks — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded mountain bathing pool under an old stone aqueduct in early afternoon — She skips one flat pebble across the still mountain pool; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing; An open-air tea stop beside a terraced pear orchard — She shares a freshly cut pear with an unseen travelling companion; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lying on her front; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — dries her hair with a towel; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing with one foot up on a step; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — seated on a chair
